### What the session covers

**Part 1 · The idea.** A quick recap of `CLAUDE.md` and skills, then the one
new idea: skills can hand files to each other. Each step writes a file the next
step reads, so you can check or re-run any step on its own. Inside a step,
**agents** do the work in parallel, one per file type.

**Part 2 · The live run.** `/collect` classifies the folder. `/synthesize`
fans out agents and writes one summary per input. `/report` prints the
proposed report structure and waits for you before writing the Word file. Then
a file is added to the folder and only one step is re-run.
:::

::: {}
### How it works

Three small skills, not one big one. `/collect` produces `output/manifest.md`;
`/synthesize` produces `output/summaries/`; `/report` assembles them into
`output/summary-report.docx` using the defaults in `CLAUDE.md` (page limit,
numbering, language). `/summarizer` runs all three in order and is the "wow"
version; the step-by-step version is the one to learn from.

The review gate is before `/report` writes anything. Automation without a
pause is how errors get into official documents.
:::
:::

### Replicate it

::: {.steps}
1. Download the zip above and unzip it. Open a terminal in the `02_summarizer` folder.
2. Make sure **Python** and `pip` are available. The pipeline reads and writes Word, PDF, Excel and PowerPoint files, which Claude Code does not parse natively, so the skills install and call `python-docx`, `python-pptx` and `openpyxl` behind the scenes.
3. Start Claude Code and run the steps one at a time:
   ```text
   claude
   /collect
   /synthesize
   /report
   ```
4. Confirm the report structure when `/report` asks. The outputs land in `output/`.
5. Run it on a folder of your own: `/summarizer path/to/your/files`.
:::

The same folder works in Codex via `AGENTS.md`, which points the agent at the
readable recipes in `skills/`.
